docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Dorothy, carried by a cyclone to Oz, follows the yellow brick road.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

L. Frank Baum (1856–1919), The Wonderful Wizard of Oz, 1900. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
